enchantments.tooltip: Dampened: This item has been in a wet environment for too long and its original power has been weakened. Combine it with a Token of Vulkoor at the Altar of Vulkoor in the Red Fens to restore it back to its former glory.
Sonic Resistance +3: Passive: +3 Enhancement bonus to your Sonic Resistance.
Sonic Guard: This item blasts those that attack the wearer, causing 1d6 sonic damage on a successful melee attack.
Resonance +48: Passive: +48 Equipment bonus to Sonic Spell Power.
Impulse +48: Passive: +48 Equipment bonus to Force, Untyped, Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning Spell Power.
